newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Sonae to open factory in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Sonae to open factory in Brazil.

text.p: Portuguese group Sonae Industria plans to build a $130 million wood products factory in Parana state in southern Brazil, a spokesman said on Wednesday.
"The factory will create 400 jobs directly and about 1,000 indirectly in the forest industry," Sonae spokesman Manuel Araujo Silva told Reuters.
He confirmed a report in Diario Economico newspaper which said that the governor of Parana, Jaime Lemer, had approved plans to build the factory in the district of Pien in Curitiba.
Araujo said the factory should start producing chipboard and medium density fibreboard at the end of 1997.
Sonae Industria is a unit of Portugal's biggest industrial group Sonae Investimentos. Sonae Industria shares stood at 1,290 escudos ($8.34) , up 10, in volume of 1,500 shares in late morning trade.
